interface_deviations.detail: ROOT-introduced packaging wire between structure and summary; additive, no frozen lane wire changed.
Section priorities live on the profile, not the route. The parameter was added after measuring that reading them off the route silently degraded every document to one generic order.

C.detail: Hengfeng two-phase construction across p62-63; Wanrun denial restored in-package; MINISO two lanes kept apart; SMIC Q1 business text organised

tests_not_run: Paid model summary fidelity and cross-company G4/G5 acceptance (parent plan scope; the layer is not wired into the production parse/select entry point).
known_gaps: Unnumbered paper headings cannot be recognised as sections: the PDF parser discards span font size and a geometry guess would misfire on equally short table fragments. Requires a parser-level change.
A QA page is emitted as two role sets (investor_question/management and qa_text_shadow) with distinct unit ids; the structure layer must not deduplicate, so the adapter/selector must choose.
Every real document returns route confidence=low because ROUTE_PROBE_LIMIT fires against the frozen 200-unit/64000-char budget; that is an honest budget state, not confident routing.
No production caller imports this layer.
US holdout is still absent; the benchmark records five acquisition requests rather than filling them synthetically.
The 20 survey samples are development seeds, not a blind holdout.

raw_preservation.detail: All four ROOT real originals and all seven PROFILES originals re-verified: SHA-256 and mtime unchanged. The benchmark measured the same for its four.

scratch_restore.detail: Host-absolute bindings live in gitignored .planning/du-root/bindings.local.json; src and tests contain no host paths (repo host-assumption guard passes). __pycache__ removed before each commit. No download, screenshot, DB or full-text copy retained.

next_root_action: Decide the probe budget, add span font size to the parser, choose one QA role set, then run the paid model node and wire the layer into the default path.

merge_phase_findings.symptom: build_dependency_packages read route['section_priorities'], but that key lives on the profile returned by get_profile(route['profile_id']); route_document does not return it. Every document therefore received the same generic priority order and routing had no effect on reading order. Nothing failed.
merge_phase_findings.fix: build_dependency_packages accepts profile= and _role_priority prefers the profile while still accepting a route; locked by tests/unit/document_understanding_root/test_du_root_lane_seam.py.

merge_phase_findings.symptom: The structure lane prepended its fixture directory to sys.path and imported a bare module named 'fixtures'. The repository also has tests/fixtures on sys.path, so running the DU suites in ONE pytest invocation (which is what CI does) failed at collection: ImportError: cannot import name 'available_inputs' from 'fixtures'. Each lane passed when run alone.
merge_phase_findings.fix: Renamed the module to the unique tests/fixtures/document_understanding_structure/du_structure_fixtures.py and import it by that name.

merge_phase_findings.symptom: tests/unit/<lane>/test_*.py computed REPO as Path(__file__).parents[2], which is <repo>/tests and not <repo>. The bindings file was therefore never found and the real-original node reported 10 SKIPPED instead of running -- an honest but misleading green.
merge_phase_findings.fix: Changed to parents[3] in the four ROOT modules. The real-original node now runs and passes (10 passed, plus the legacy-vs-new comparison). NOTE: the structure lane's own FIXTURE_ROOT uses parents[2]/'fixtures'/... at the same depth and is CORRECT; it must not be changed.

open_gate.item: implementation.md step 7 paid model node and step 8 production switch
open_gate.status: NOT RUN - deliberately deferred, with a concrete reason
reasons: The plan itself sequences this work into the parent plan's G4/G5 window: '生产切换与真实模型大节点按母计划 G4/G5 另行执行'. The plan also states this layer's G4/G5 acceptance must not be replaced or marked complete by this lane.
The layer is intentionally not wired into the production parse/select/summarize entry point, so a 'same-config real summary' would first require the step-8 wiring that the plan places AFTER G4/G5.

No cumulative USD/token cap is present in config.yaml (only per-call limits: llm.max_tokens=8192, llm_max_input_chars=120000). The historical llm_cost_log.csv already records ~43.0 USD and ~282.7M tokens over 7025 rows, far above the plan's cited $20/2M figure, so headroom against the real cumulative cap cannot be established from the files available here. Spending without that cannot be justified.
open_gate.provider_keys: Model credentials do exist in the main checkout's .env (DEEPSEEK/MINIMAX/MIMO), so this is a budget-and-sequencing gate, NOT a missing-configuration gate.
open_gate.how_to_proceed: Confirm the current cumulative budget headroom, wire the layer into the production summary path, then run the real-model node and the parent plan G4/G5 reviews.
